fomod.Name: CTD - Crash to Desktop Reporter
fomod.Author: ezmode.games
fomod.Description:
Automatic crash reporting for Skyrim SE/AE.
When your game crashes, CTD captures detailed diagnostic information including your mod list, load order, and crash location. This data is sent to ctd.ezmode.games where it's analyzed to help identify mod conflicts and compatibility issues.
Features: - Automatic crash detection via Windows SEH - Captures full mod fingerprints (hash, size, version) - Identifies crash location in loaded modules - Privacy-focused: no personal data collected - Lightweight: minimal performance impact
Requires SKSE64.
